notes: Runs moment's core unit tests (src/test/moment/*.js, the 'moment' half of `grunt qtest`) with npm qunit under plain node, via /opt/tc/qunit-tap.js (one TAP line per QUnit test). build_cmd replaces `grunt transpile-raw` with /opt/tc/moment-build.js, which rebuilds only build/umd/moment.js and build/umd/test/moment/*.js with rollup 0.67 (same UMD output, header templates and skipLines as tasks/transpile.js), so injected src/lib changes are tested. Locale tests (src/test/locale, ~120 files testing locale data) are not run; src/locale is excluded from src_globs as data. Only rollup and qunit are installed (grunt, karma, lint, nyc omitted), resolved as of 2019-01-22. Image TZ=UTC.
